context_requirements: Cardiomyogenesis inducers act on developmental cardiac lineage programs that are not active in the nine immortalized non-cardiac human lines used here.
A responsive cell would need to be a cardiac progenitor or pluripotent cell capable of cardiomyocyte differentiation; none of the nine lines have this context.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines that is shared across multiple structurally unrelated cardiomyogenesis inducers.
Induction of canonical cardiac lineage markers among the landmark genes (e.g., MYC, GATA4, MEF2C, NKX2-5, TBX5) in a non-cardiac line.
A pattern of generic proliferation, apoptosis, or stress responses that is specific to this class rather than shared with unrelated cytotoxic drugs.
